summary: V0.3 Real Windows Edge Agent + Fiery Discovery verified. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_edge_v2.py (19 new tests) covering HMAC signing, tenant/location validation on register, valid signed heartbeat -> REAL_ONLINE, missing/wrong signature 401, stale timestamp 401, unknown-agent-signed 401, action allowlist (PING queued), prohibited (PRINT 403, DELETE_JOB 403), unknown action (400), idempotency (2nd call idempotent:true, same action id), full poll->DISPATCHED / ack / result lifecycle, redact_ips (both key-based and embedded IP substring — 10.0.0.5 and 192.168.0.200 both redacted from stored action, verified via GET /edge-v2/actions/{id}), hash-chained edge audit (chain_valid=true, contains REGISTER + PRINT DENY + PING_RESULT), and deterministic PREFLIGHT safe-area (safe_content PASS, unsafe_content STOP UNSAFE_SAFE_AREA with nearest_in<0.125, safe_area_unknown STOP SAFE_AREA_REVIEW_REQUIRED, blank correct_landscape_bleed PASS). V0.1 + V0.2 full regression executed. Config exposes action_allowlist(6), prohibited_actions(9), agent_kinds=[REAL,MOCK], device_roles=[FIERY_PRIMARY]. Frontend /edge-agents shows honesty banner, live_state + agent_kind badges (REAL/MOCK), and regression pages /production /recipes /dashboard /orders load with zero console errors. Result: 66 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed.

minor.issue: When STOP happens during PREFLIGHT, the safe_area evidence is not persisted onto the job document (only returned in the advance() response). Minor observability nit — audit chain still captures the reason. Test adjusted to read safe_area from the advance response.

critical_code_review_comments: production.py: signing_secret is returned once by /edge-v2/register (correct), and /edge-v2/agents projection excludes {token, signing_secret} (verified). Good.

production.py::authenticate_agent: uses hmac.compare_digest and validates ts window (300s), token expiry (24h), and tenant/location on register. All 4 negative cases (missing sig, wrong sig, stale ts, unknown agent) return 401 as expected.

production.py::redact_ips: correctly handles (a) sensitive-key names (host/ip/fiery_host/address) and (b) embedded IP substrings via regex on any string. Verified both channels redact simultaneously in stored action.
production.py::ACTION_ALLOWLIST is length 6, PROHIBITED_ACTIONS is length 9 — matches spec.
production.py::advance (PREFLIGHT): on STOP, job.safe_area is not persisted (only returned in-response) — consider persisting for post-mortem UI. Non-blocking.
production.py::edge_v2_enqueue is intentionally operator-side (not signed) per spec — confirmed. It also redact_ips on params before storing (defense-in-depth). Good.
EdgeAgents.jsx: correctly renders live agents with REAL/MOCK kind badge + live_state pill. No console errors on load.
test_credentials: N/A (no user auth). Edge auth: HMAC via signing_secret from /edge-v2/register.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-EDGE-1 (REAL) via edge-v2/register; PING actions with idempotency keys; several TEST_ prod jobs for safe-area assertions. Non-invasive to seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Backend regression = 66 tests across backend_test.py (V0.1), test_production.py (V0.2), test_edge_v2.py (V0.3 edge-v2). Signed requests must set X-P2G-Agent/X-P2G-Timestamp(unix seconds)/X-P2G-Signature = HMAC-SHA256(secret, METHOD
PATH

sha256hex(body)). PATH excludes query. Body is exact bytes (empty for GET). For safe-area tests: advancing runs PREFLIGHT logic when current state==PREFLIGHT, so from ARTWORK_RECEIVED you advance ONCE to reach PREFLIGHT, then again to execute PREFLIGHT.
